title: Super Saiyan Goku
description: A stylized close-up illustration of Goku, a prominent character from the Dragon Ball series, in his Super Saiyan form.  He is depicted with spiky, blond hair charged with golden energy, intense green eyes, and a determined expression.  Electric energy crackles around him, emphasizing his power and readiness for battle. The art style is reminiscent of anime and manga, with bold lines, dynamic posing, and vibrant colors.
